text: BAM share rose 1.44 percentage points over 28 hours and 1.03 percentage points over 7 days, reaching 37.0% of all Solana stake routed through BAM. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-2-tee holds 25% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. Top-node leadership changed hands 66 times in the window, consistent with whale-driven routing rather than a structural rollover; only the fra rollover on 2026-06-24 has been validated.
